figurative_meaning_en: Disputes or arguments conducted through writing or paperwork
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুই পক্ষের মধ্যে লেখালেখি চলছে অনেক দিন ধরে।
এই লেখালেখির ফলে মামলা আরও জটিল হয়ে উঠেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: There has been a lot of back-and-forth writing between the two parties for days.
This paperwork dispute has made the case even more complicated.
note: Refers to bureaucratic or legal exchanges typical in Bengali administrative contexts
